title: TAE Technologies–Trump Media merger announced two days after Loureiro's death
summary: Jesse Michels tells of TAE Technologies–Trump Media merger announced two days after Loureiro's death, about December 2025 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The deal was announced on December 18th, 2025. Lorero died on December 16th.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that a merger deal between a company called TAE Technologies and Trump Media was announced on December 18, 2025, and that a man named Loureiro died two days earlier, on December 16. He raises the timing in an episode about American scientists going missing, hinting that the two events might be connected.
